$comment: Machine-readable record of the 2026-08-19 Eve field-test session. Companion to the human report; written at the end of the session from git, the forge, App Store Connect, Vercel and Postgres — not from memory.

session.objective: Use the app as a creator would, end to end, and report what actually happens
session.method: Voice via the ElevenLabs rig into the Simulator mic; taps via computer-use; evidence from local-logs transcripts, Metro [live] lines, Postgres, the forge box and the GitHub compare API
session.credits_note: The Advanced plan covers generation; credit_ledger shows only the original signup bonus.

scenarios.name: Build a brand from a conversation
scenarios.detail: Voice interview → Brand Compiled → store live in 2m20s. Palette (#36454F/#95a5a6/#ff4500) and typography were derived from the conversation, never asked for.

scenarios.name: Design a design and publish it
scenarios.detail: Generate → enhance → placement → pricing → publish all completed. The product was written to the creator's OLDEST brand instead of the new one.

scenarios.name: Edit the website through the UI
scenarios.detail: Circle-and-speak produced revisions that built, deployed a preview and reported ready while changing nothing. Root-caused to three separate defects; after fixing all three the loop completed end to end including the merge to live.

scenarios.name: Website graphics (ASSETS spoke)
scenarios.detail: Session pivoted to fixes and release work before this scenario was reached.

findings.title: A new brand's designs are published to the creator's oldest brand
findings.cause: getCreatorStore() returns the oldest store by createdAt (src/lib/tenant.ts:63) and /api/catalogues binds the design flow to it at the first step; every later step inherits that binding. /api/publish is correct — it uses the composition's store.
evidence: designs.store_id = f303be42 (night-circuit) for a session begun immediately after creating Sardine Club
findings.real_world_impact: Three test products from earlier API-path testing were live on the real Stephen Lawyer storefront. Removed this session.

findings.title: The forge robot never ran, and every revision still reported ready
findings.cause: The forge's CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN was revoked. `claude -p "…" || true` swallowed the 401, and the worker's only failure check was a missing REVISE_DONE marker.
evidence: /tmp/store-sardine-club-revise.log: 'Failed to authenticate. API Error: 401 OAuth access token has been revoked.'
The provision brief specified hero copy 'FOR THE LAST TRAIN HOME.'; the live site served the stock template line
findings.fix: Worker reports CLAUDE_OK/CLAUDE_FAILED and, after staging, NO_EDITS when the brief is the only change. Either fails the revision and notifies the creator. Provisioning records the same rather than passing an unbranded template off as the brand.

findings.title: A backtick in a shell comment truncated the entire revise script
findings.cause: Self-inflicted, in the F2 fix. The forge script is a JS template literal; backticks in an added comment closed it. worker.mjs still parsed (node --check passed) but the emitted shell stopped after `pnpm install`.
evidence: Revision failed in 3 seconds with 'forge revision did not complete'
/tmp/store-sardine-club-revise.log mtime unchanged — claude was never invoked
findings.fix: Comment rewritten without backticks, plus a render-the-script-and-assert-every-marker check that the JS syntax pass cannot do.

findings.title: Every circle on the live site committed zero points
findings.cause: setDraftStrokes((s) => [...s, cur.current]) reads cur.current when React FLUSHES the updater, not when it is called — and the next line reset the buffer, so the empty array landed in state.
evidence: before: [critique] mark 0 pts=0 centre=NaN,NaN → hit 0 → null → 'circled: somewhere on the page'
after:  [critique] mark 0 pts=38 centre=275,279 → hit 0 → the "hero" section
findings.consequence: No mark drawn, no region resolved, no annotated screenshot captured — while the forge brief instructed the robot to read the annotated screenshots.

findings.title: A returning creator's brand interview runs on the wrong persona
findings.cause: MODE_JOBS.central is design/assets/status — no brand job. Comments in live-voice.ts and eve-home.tsx still claim the interview module rides along verbatim; true before the agent-file rewrite, not after.
findings.note: She still called save_brand and compiled a correct brand, so this is drift rather than a break.

findings.title: She proposes products the platform cannot make
evidence: EVE: 'We could do premium noise-cancelling headphones or bespoke coffee and energy blends.' — the catalogue is Printful apparel and accessories
findings.cause: jobs/design.md bounds who picks the product but never what can be printed.

findings.title: The live socket drops mid-turn and gives up after one reconnect
evidence: ws close 1007 'The audio content type (CONTENT_TYPE_AUDIO) is not supported for this model configuration' — twice, mid-utterance
ws close 1011 service unavailable; ws close 1001 stream end
Consequence: she skipped the enhance-or-as-is line; a whole sentence reached the router as the single word 'club'
findings.cause: live-voice.ts:511 allows one automatic reconnect per session and the counter is never reset.

findings.title: 'Put it on the All shirt'
findings.cause: eve-design.tsx:352 derives the CTA noun from the Printful category and strips a trailing s: 'All shirts' → 'All shirt', 'All hats' → 'All hat'.

findings.title: Publish defaults: off-brand colour and zero margin
findings.detail: Colour pre-selected as Aqua (first alphabetically) for a charcoal/orange brand previewed on black; retail price defaulted to $24.69 against a stated minimum of $24.69.

findings.title: Beta signups on nanocrew.app reached nothing at all
findings.cause: /api/waitlist ran `create table if not exists waitlist` against DATABASE_URL, which nanocrew-site does not hold by design, so every signup fell through to a console.log. The waitlist table did not exist. OAuth signups never called the waitlist at all.
findings.fix: Moved to platform-api, which holds the database, the mailer and the App Store Connect key.

findings.title: Site-editor chrome: clipped, racing captions, invisible marks
findings.detail: Subtitles sat under the tab bar and painted the transcript seconds ahead of her audio; the orb, pen and keyboard buttons and the Send-to-Eve confirm were clipped.
findings.fix: Captions moved under the URL bar, trimmed to the last five words, paced against the wall-clock window of her queued audio; panels reserve the tab bar via tabBarSpace().
findings.still_open: The revision review offers Continue editing and Approve edits but no discard; scenarios.md S3 routes through Site Options, which is a direct text/colour form, not the circle-and-speak editor.

findings.title: Outward-facing surfaces still wore the retired identity
findings.detail: Email pointed at nanocrew.app/nc-icon.png — the June serif NC monogram. The social share card (opengraph-image.tsx, re-exported by twitter-image.tsx) was still #c9a86a gold, Georgia and the serif NC box, against the site's own 'no gold, no warm neutrals' rule.
findings.fix: Both rebuilt on Eve's constellation, the app palette and Jost. gen-app-icon.mjs now emits the email mark and sender avatar so they cannot drift from the app icon.

findings.title: Session voice drift in the longest persona
findings.detail: Her accent is prompt-carried only — native audio rejects speechConfig.languageCode, so the model auto-detects. In the critique mode (10k chars, job plus the whole vocabulary brief) the 'British' cue at the top was far enough from the end that some sessions arrived Australian or American.
findings.mitigation: The accent is now anchored in the LAST line of every persona as well as the first, and [live] persona … now logs voice= and outRate= so a wrong voice is provable rather than argued.
findings.proof_it_was_not_config: voice=Kore and outRate=24000/24000 on every session, central and critique alike.

turn_length.riffing: 44–60 words without asking for the room

statement_to_question.value: never two questions in a row

net_new_rate.value: an idea, observation or specific compliment every turn

persona_change.change: The ask for more room must come BEFORE the extra room, not after — headline version first, then hand them the choice.
persona_change.trigger: Joe, mid-session: 'it was really long… she should try to truncate her response, and say want to hear more?'

signup form, waitlist proxy, rebuilt social card, brand assets

forge_token.problem: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN revoked; the commented fallback API key authenticated but the Console account had no credits (HTTP 400, 'credit balance is too low')
forge_token.resolution: Joe minted a new token; the masked dialog truncated it to 80 of 108 characters, which the box reported as 'invalid' rather than 'revoked'. Taken from the clipboard instead and written over stdin — never on a command line, never in the transcript.
forge_token.verified: claude -p on the box returned FORGE_AUTH_OK

brand_surfaces.resend_team_avatar: Uploaded 2026-08-19 via the Resend dashboard (Settings → Team → Avatar); confirmed persisted after reload
brand_surfaces.inbox_avatar_note: Resend's team avatar is dashboard-only. What a recipient sees beside the sender is resolved by their mail client from the sending domain (BIMI, or the address's own profile), not from Resend and not from our HTML.
brand_surfaces.social_card: nanocrew-site/app/opengraph-image.tsx — rendered on request, re-exported by twitter-image.tsx
